blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Smart wearable devices, such as augmented reality glasses, increasingly rely on cameras to understand and interact with their surroundings. However, their compact sensors often capture noisy RAW images, while limited compute and power make high-quality on-device restoration difficult. This creates an emerging need to reduce both local computation and transmission cost without sacrificing image quality. Two common solutions are to offload restoration or to compress the raw data before transmission. The first makes RAW transmission costly; the second reduces the payload but can spend bitrate preserving sensor noise. We address this fundamental mismatch with an asymmetric framework for joint RAW compression and restoration that directly optimizes the transmitted representation for clean image reconstruction. A lightweight on-device encoder compresses noisy RAW measurements into a bitstream, while a higher-capacity backend decoder jointly denoises and demosaics the encoded representation. We use knowledge distillation to train a smaller encoder for tighter compute budgets. Experiments on real and synthetic data show improved rate-restoration performance over strong cascaded compression-restoration pipelines and learned compression baselines. On SIDD, our method improves PSNR by more than 1.5 dB over cascaded baselines at approximately 0.25 bits per pixel. We further validate the method on real 12 MP RAW images captured with commercial smart glasses and measure sender-side latency on both smartphone and smart-glasses hardware. The distilled encoder achieves a 27.6$\times$ NPU inference speedup over on-device NAFNet for 256$\times$256 output patches. The code is available at https://github.com/coolsyn2000/CRAW
blocks.zh: 智能的可穿戴设备,如增强现实眼镜,越来越依赖摄像机来理解和与周围环境互动. 然而,其紧凑的传感器往往能捕捉吵闹的RAW图像,而有限的计算和功率使得高品质的机载设备修复变得困难. 这就产生了在不牺牲图像质量的情况下降低本地计算和传输成本的新需要。 两种常见的解决方案是卸载恢复,或在传输前压缩原始数据. 第一种方法使RAW传输成本高;第二种方法减少有效载荷,但可以花费比特率保存传感器噪音。 我们用一个非对称的框架来解决这种根本性的不匹配,即联合RAW压缩和恢复,直接优化传输的图像重建表现。 轻量级的装订编码器将噪音的RAW测量压缩成位流,而功率较高的后端解码器将编码的表示法联合凹陷并演示出来. 我们用知识蒸馏来训练一个更小的编码器来进行更严格的计算预算. 关于真实和合成数据的实验显示,相对于强大的级联压缩-恢复管道和所学的压缩基线,速率恢复性能有所改善。 在SIDD上,我们的方法将PSNR改进了超过1.5 dB的级联基线,每像素约0.25比特. 我们进一步验证使用商业智能眼镜捕获的12 MP RAW真实图像上的方法,并在智能手机和智能眼镜硬件上测量发送方的潜伏度. 蒸馏编码器实现27.6美元\times$ NPU推导速度在device NAFNet上,以256美元\times$256输出补丁. 该守则可在https://github.com/coolsyn2000/CRAW上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Smart wearable devices, such as augmented reality (AR) glasses, use compact camera modules with small sensors and apertures to meet strict size and weight constraints. Head and body motion further necessitate short exposure times to limit motion blur. Together, the limited light collection and short exposure times reduce the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the captured RAW images. At low SNR, conventional denoising methods can struggle to suppress noise while preserving fine image detail [ 9 ] . Deep neural networks are widely used for RAW restoration, offering improved image quality by jointly performing denoising and demosaicing [ 5 , 31 , 15 ] . At the same time, wearable vision benefits from high-resolution imaging to preserve fine spatial details. However, high-resolution RAW restoration remains computationally demanding, especially on smart wearable devices, considering their tight compute, memory, power, and thermal budgets.
blocks.zh: 智能的可穿戴设备,如增强现实(AR)眼镜,使用带有小传感器和孔径的紧凑相机模块,以达到严格的尺寸和重量限制. 头部和身体运动进一步需要短暂的接触时间来限制运动模糊. 光采集有限和曝光时间短共同降低了捕捉到的RAW图像的信号-噪声比(SNR). 在低SNR,常规的除噪方法在保存精细的图像细节的同时可以挣扎抑制噪声[9]. 深神经网络被广泛用于RAW修复,通过联合进行除音和演示[5,31,15],提供了更好的图像质量. 同时,可穿戴的视觉也得益于高分辨率成像来保存细微的空间细节. 然而,高分辨率RAW修复在计算上仍然要求很高,特别是在智能可穿戴设备方面,因为其计算严格、内存、功率和热能预算。

blocks.en: This shifts the problem from designing a better restorer to deciding how the restoration workload should be split between the wearable device and a more capable backend. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , fully on-device image restoration ( Fig. 1 (a)) avoids RAW transmission but requires the wearable to perform the entire restoration. Sending uncompressed RAW to a paired phone or cloud server shifts the restoration workload off the wearable, but transmitting full-resolution RAW frames can incur substantial latency over a bandwidth-limited wireless link. Codec-cascaded backend image restoration ( Fig. 1 (b)) reduces the transmission payload by compressing the noisy RAW on the wearable before restoring it at the backend. This raises a central question for wearable imaging: under a tight on-device compute budget, how can we reduce the bitrate needed to achieve a given restoration quality?
blocks.zh: 这把问题从设计更好的恢复器转向决定如何在可穿戴装置和功能更强的后端之间分配恢复工作量. 如图1所示,完全安装在设备上的图像修复(图1(a))避免了RAW传输,但要求穿戴者完成整个修复工作。 将未压缩的RAW发送到一个配对的电话或云服务器会将修复工作量从可穿戴量中转移出去,但传输全分辨率RAW帧可能会在带宽有限的无线链接上产生相当的耐久性. 编码封装的后端图像恢复(图1(b))通过在后端恢复可穿戴器上压缩噪音的RAW来减少传输有效载荷. 这引起了一个可穿戴成像的核心问题:在一个紧凑的设备计算预算下,我们怎样才能降低实现特定修复质量所需的比特率?

blocks.en: Conventional compression codecs, such as JPEG-XL (JXL) and VVC, are ill-suited to this wearable setting. They are designed to reproduce their input faithfully, so they may also encode sensor noise together with the underlying signal in low-SNR measurements. At high bitrates, many of the bits are spent on encoding useless noise that the backend restoration module will discard later, which wastes valuable bandwidth and increases transmission latency. At low bitrates, the cost is even worse: noise competes with the clean signal for the very limited bit budgets, and the signal lost in the compression stage cannot be recovered. Compression also alters the nature of the degradation itself. Sensor noise is approximately pixel-independent and is well described by a calibrated Poisson–Gaussian noise model [ 35 ] , whereas quantization and partition-based transforms of conventional compression codecs convert it into spatially correlated color bias or blocking artifacts. The backend restoration algorithm therefore receives out-of-distribution noisy inputs with artifacts that a sensor noise model does not capture. Such artifacts are considerably harder to learn and remove than the original pixel-independent sensor noise [ 18 , 25 ] . As shown in Fig. 2 , JXL compression of a noisy RAW image introduces color artifacts and loses fine texture that cannot be recovered after restoration by NAFNet [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 常规压缩编码器,如JPEG-XL(JXL)和VVC,不适合这种可穿戴的设置. 它们被设计成忠实地复制其输入,因此它们也可能在低SNR测量中将传感器噪声与基础信号一起编码. 在高比特率时,许多比特用于编码无用的噪声,后端恢复模块日后会丢弃这些噪声,这些噪声浪费了宝贵的带宽,增加了传输延迟. 在低比特率下,成本更糟糕:噪音与干净的信号争夺非常有限的比特预算,压缩阶段丢失的信号无法恢复. 压抑也会改变退化本身的性质. 感应噪声大约是像素独立的,被一个校准的Poisson–Gausian噪声模型[35]很好地描述,而常规压缩编码器的四分法和以分区为基础的变换则将其转化为空间相关的色彩偏差或阻塞文物. 因此,后端恢复算法接收出分流的噪音输入,其中含有传感器噪声模型无法捕捉的文物. 这些文物比原始的像素独立传感器噪声[18,25]更难学习和清除. 如法智所显. 2,JXL压缩一个吵闹的RAW图像引入了彩色文物,失去了NAFNet修复后无法恢复的精细纹理[10].

blocks.en: Figure 2 : JXL compression of noisy RAW. At 0.44 bpp, JXL introduces color artifacts and removes fine texture that NAFNet fails to recover in this LSDIR example at ISO 3200.

blocks.en: Instead of treating compression and restoration as separate stages, we formulate wearable RAW imaging as a joint compression–restoration problem under an on-device compute constraint ( Fig. 1 (c)). By optimizing the transmitted representation for clean linear RGB reconstruction, our joint design improves the trade-off between communication cost and restored image quality, leading to higher restoration quality at the same bitrate as cascaded compression and restoration. In our proposed framework, an edge-efficient encoder model maps the noisy RAW measurements to a compact latent on the front-end. A higher-capacity decoder at the paired phone or cloud server then decompresses the latents and jointly denoises, demosaics, then reconstructs the clean linear RGB image at the backend. This design meets the emerging need for high-quality wearable imaging under tight compute and bandwidth constraints. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • Problem formulation. We formulate wearable noisy-RAW restoration as a joint computation–restoration problem, under an explicit on-device compute budget, jointly accounting for reconstruction quality, transmitted bitrate, and on-device inference cost. • Edge-efficient architecture. We propose a joint RAW compression and restoration architecture that pairs a distilled, edge-efficient encoder with a high-capacity decoder, trained end-to-end from noisy RAW to clean linear RGB targets. It outperforms codec-adapted cascades and learned compression baselines on realistic and synthetic noisy RAW image datasets. • On-device evaluation. We deploy our framework on real-world devices and report the latency for sender devices, including NPU inference, data I/O, CPU coding, and transmission. Evaluations are performed with 12 MP ( 4032 × 3024 4032\times 3024 ) RAW images on both smartphone (Xiaomi 13) and AR glasses (Rokid Glasses) platforms.
blocks.zh: 我们不把压缩和恢复作为单独的阶段处理,而是将可穿戴的RAW成像作为联合压缩-恢复问题,置于设备的计算制约下(图1(c))。 通过优化清洁线性RGB重建的传输代表,我们联合设计改善了通信成本与恢复图像质量之间的权衡,导致与级联压缩和修复相同的比特率更高的恢复质量. 在我们提议的框架中,一个边缘效率高的编码器模型将吵闹的RAW测量结果映射到前端的紧凑潜伏. 在配对的电话或云服务器上装有更高容量的解码器,然后解压潜伏物并联合凹陷,演示,然后在后端重建干净的线性RGB图像. 这种设计满足了在严格计算和带宽限制下新出现的高质量可穿戴成像的需求. 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们用明确的设备计算预算,共同计算重建质量、传输比特率和设备推导成本,将可穿戴的噪声-RAW修复作为联合计算-恢复问题。 • 边缘高效建筑。 我们提出一个联合RAW压缩与恢复架构,将一个蒸馏的,边缘高效的编码器与一个高容量的解码器配对,经过训练的端对端从吵吵的RAW到清洁线性RGB目标. 它超越了经编码调整的级联和在现实和合成吵闹的RAW图像数据集上学习的压缩基线. • 现场评价。 我们部署关于现实世界设备的框架,并报告发送设备的延迟性,包括NPU推论,数据I/O,CPU编码和传输. 使用智能手机(小米13)和AR眼镜(Rokid Glasses)两个平台的12 MP(4032×3024 4032\times 3024)RAW图像进行评价.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Hardware-aware learned image compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 硬件知识图像压缩

blocks.en: For wearable imaging, compression must reduce transmission cost without adding too much computation at the sender. Learned image codecs are attractive because they optimize compression end to end with a differentiable rate–distortion objective, using learned priors to model the latents [ 4 , 30 , 20 ] . RAW-oriented codecs extend this idea to high-bit-depth sensor data [ 27 ] . Stronger context models, however, improve compression at the cost of serial dependence and additional computation. This has motivated designs that keep entropy coding parallel [ 21 ] or distribute computation asymmetrically across the two endpoints [ 37 , 43 , 34 ] . PICO further evaluates accelerator execution together with the cost of entropy coding [ 33 ] , and CoDiSP partitions camera-image signal processing (ISP) through a task-oriented compressed representation [ 41 ] . These studies establish the value of hardware-aware evaluation, but their objective is still to reconstruct the encoder input or a task-specific representation. As a result, valuable bitrate can be spent preserving sensor noise, while the sender may still be too expensive for a wearable device.
blocks.zh: 对于可穿戴的成像,压缩必须降低传输成本,而不在发送者身上添加过多的计算. 所学的图像编码器很有吸引力,因为它们优化了压缩端,以不同的速率—扭曲目标结束,利用所学的前科来模拟潜伏[4,30,20]. RAW面向的编码器将这个想法扩展到高位深度的传感器数据[27]. 然而,更强的上下文模型以连环依赖和额外的计算为代价来改进压缩. 这有激励性的设计,可以保持Entropy编码平行[21]或者在两个端点之间不对称地分布计算[37,43,34]. PICO还进一步评价加速器执行与 en编码成本[33],CoDISP通过面向任务的压缩表示处理相机-图像信号(ISP)[41]. 这些研究确立了硬件意识评价的价值,但其目标仍然是重建编码器输入或特定任务的代表. 因此,宝贵的比特率可以被花在保存传感器噪声上,而发送者对于一个可穿戴的设备来说可能仍然过于昂贵.

blocks.en: 2.2 Efficient RAW restoration
blocks.zh: 2.2 高效的RAW修复

blocks.en: Beyond compression, the restoration stage must also recover image quality from noisy sensor measurements. RAW restoration recovers a full-color image from mosaiced, signal-dependent measurements. The RAW domain is attractive because sensor noise is well characterized before the nonlinear stages of the ISP, so the degradation can be modeled accurately. Early work therefore focused on joint demosaicing and denoising directly [ 22 , 17 ] . As learning-based restoration became more data-driven, progress increasingly depended on both training data and network design. SIDD provides paired real smartphone captures [ 1 ] , although real acquisition is expensive and the resulting scene diversity is limited. To broaden training data, Unprocessing synthesizes realistic RAW pairs from clean sRGB images [ 5 ] , which makes training on more diverse content practical. On the model side, Restormer and NAFNet achieve strong quality through long-range modeling or simplified convolutional blocks [ 39 , 10 ] , but their inference cost is far beyond a wearable budget. This has motivated mobile-oriented designs that reduce arithmetic and memory traffic and restrict the network to NPU-friendly operators [ 38 , 29 , 14 , 16 ] , at a measurable cost in restoration quality. As a result, efficient RAW restoration for wearable devices remains challenging: the model must preserve restoration quality while operating under tight on-device compute and memory budgets. These constraints motivate architectures that shift more of the restoration workload away from the wearable while keeping the transmitted representation compact.
blocks.zh: 除了压缩外,恢复阶段还必须从噪音传感器测量中恢复图像质量. RAW修复后从镶嵌的,信号依赖的测量中恢复了全色图像. RAW域具有吸引力,因为感官噪声在ISP的非线性阶段之前具有良好的特征,因此降解可以精确地建模. 因此,早期工作的重点是直接联合降级和降级[22、17]。 由于基于学习的恢复工作越来越受数据驱动,进展越来越取决于培训数据和网络设计。 SIDD提供配对的真智能手机捕捉[1],虽然真正的获取成本昂贵,由此产生的场景多样性有限. 为了拓宽培训数据,Unprocess综合了从干净的SRGB图像中合成现实的RAW配对[5],这使得关于更多样化内容的培训变得实用. 在模型方面,Reformer和NAFNet通过远程建模或简化的演化区块[39,10]实现强质量,但其推论成本远超出可穿戴的预算. 这推动了面向移动的设计,减少了算术和内存流量,并将网络限制在对NPU友好的运营商[38,29,14,16],在修复质量上可以衡量成本. 因此,可穿戴设备的有效RAW修复仍然具有挑战性:该模型必须保持修复质量,同时在紧凑的设备计算和内存预算下运行. 这些制约因素促使结构将更多的修复工作量从可磨损的工作量转移开来,同时保持所传送的代表契约。

blocks.en: 2.3 Joint Compression and Restoration
blocks.zh: 2.3 联合镇压和恢复

blocks.en: A natural way to reduce both transmission and restoration cost is to optimize the two tasks together. Joint compression and restoration focuses the transmitted information on what is needed to recover a clean image, while avoiding unnecessary coding of the degraded input. Early methods optimize denoising and compression under a shared rate–distortion objective [ 7 , 12 , 8 ] . Later work introduces noise-adaptive variational coding [ 23 ] or merges decompression and denoising inside a single decoder [ 11 ] . More recently, CLEANS [ 28 ] compresses the clean signal from noisy RAW in a self-supervised manner using a calibrated physical noise model. All-in-One Compression and Restoration [ 40 ] extends joint compression and restoration to multiple degradation types. These methods show the benefit of optimizing compression for clean reconstruction. However, smart wearable device-based cameras pose a largely unexplored challenge: balancing bitrate and reconstruction quality under tight sender-side compute constraints. We address this with the asymmetric design described in Sec. 3 .
blocks.zh: 降低传输成本和恢复成本的自然方式是将这两项任务合在一起优化. 联合压缩和恢复将传输的信息集中于恢复清洁图像所需的内容,同时避免对退化的输入进行不必要的编码。 早期方法在一个共享率-扭曲目标[7,12,8]下优化去诺和压缩. 后来的作品引入了噪声适应变异编码[23],或者将一个单一解码器内部的解压和解码合并[11]. 最近,CLEANS [28] 使用校准物理噪声模型,以自我监督的方式压缩来自噪音RAW的清洁信号. All-in-One压缩与恢复[40]将联合压缩与恢复扩展到多种降解类型. 这些方法显示了优化压缩以进行清洁重建的好处. 然而,智能可穿戴的基于设备的相机构成一个基本未探索的挑战:在紧凑的发送方-侧计算限制下平衡比特率与重建质量. 我们用第3节所述的不对称设计来解决这个问题。

blocks.en: Edge-efficient encoder. Figure 3 gives an overview of the system. We build the analysis transform from dense convolutions with static shapes for efficient NPU execution. Ours-M downsamples in three stages, each opening with a 3 × \times 3 stride-2 convolution and ReLU and followed by 1, 3, and 5 residual bottleneck blocks at widths of 224, 448, and 640. Each bottleneck applies 1 × \times 1, 3 × \times 3, and 1 × \times 1 convolutions over a half-width hidden representation with a residual connection, which keeps most of the arithmetic in the two pointwise layers. A final 1 × \times 1 projection produces the 320-channel latent, which together with Bayer packing places 𝐲 \mathbf{y} at 1/16 of the sensor resolution. The sender contains no autoregressive loop [ 30 , 13 ] , dynamic routing [ 19 ] , or operators unsupported by mobile NPUs such as GDN [ 3 ] , so the whole path compiles to a single static graph.

blocks.en: Ours-S narrows the three analysis stages of the sender while keeping its topology, the latent shape, and the backend decoder architecture unchanged. Sender capacity thus varies without changing the coding interface: both variants produce latents in the same shape and incur the same backend cost. This also allows Ours-M to serve as both the initialization and the alignment target when distilling Ours-S ( Sec. 3.3 ). At deployment, both variants use the same backend network architecture with their own fine-tuned weights.
blocks.zh: Ours-S缩小了发送者的三个分析阶段,同时保持其地形,潜伏形状,以及后端解码器架构不变. 因此,发送者的能力在不改变编码接口的情况下有所不同:两种变体都产生相同形状的潜伏,并产生相同的后端成本. 这也使得Ours-M在蒸馏Ours-S(3.3 sec. 3)时既可以作为初始化目标,也可以作为对齐目标. 在部署时,两个变体都使用相同的后端网络架构,并有自己的微调重量.

blocks.en: Parallel entropy model. To fully exploit the parallelism of the mobile NPU, we keep the sender’s probability model free of serial dependencies. This matters because the sender needs the predicted mean and scale of 𝐲 ^ \hat{\mathbf{y}} to entropy-code it, so h s h_{s} runs on the device as well as on the backend. Context models improve compression by conditioning each element on previously coded neighbors [ 30 ] ; even parallel-friendly variants [ 21 , 20 ] still require multiple sequential passes, which underutilize the NPU. We instead rely on a mean–scale hyperprior alone [ 4 , 30 ] . The hyper-analysis transform maps 𝐲 \mathbf{y} to a 192-channel 𝐳 \mathbf{z} , and two upsampling layers then predict the 320-channel mean and scale maps for the entire main latent from 𝐳 ^ \hat{\mathbf{z}} in a single pass. 𝐳 ^ \hat{\mathbf{z}} is coded with an entropy bottleneck, and 𝐲 ^ \hat{\mathbf{y}} with a Gaussian conditional model under a fixed quantization step q = 0.15 q=0.15 . Finally, the CPU performs rANS entropy coding using the predicted distributions.

blocks.en: Backend-heavy reconstruction. The cost of a convolution grows with its spatial resolution, and the high-resolution layers near the output are also where fine detail is recovered. We therefore keep the sender to lightweight downsampling and place all high-resolution upsampling operations on the backend. Starting from the 320-channel latent, the synthesis transform stacks three stages of NAFBlocks [ 10 ] and attention, with an upsampling step between consecutive stages. A final transposed convolution produces 12 output channels, which a 2 × \times PixelShuffle [ 32 ] rearranges into three-channel linear RGB images at full sensor resolution.
blocks.zh: 后端重力重建. 演化的成本随着其空间分辨率的增加而增加,靠近输出的高分辨率层也是回收细节的地方. 因此,我们让发送者进行轻量级下采样,并将所有高分辨率上采样操作置于后端. 从320通道潜伏开始,合成变形堆叠了NAFBlocks[10]的三个阶段和注意力,在连续的阶段之间有一个升序步骤. 最终的转录转录产生12个输出通道,一个2×\times PixelShuffle [32] 以全传感器分辨率重排成三通道线性RGB图像.

blocks.en: Real and synthetic data. SIDD [ 1 ] is our primary real smartphone image restoration dataset. We use 144 training scenes and 16 disjoint validation scenes from all five phone cameras over ISO 50–10000, converting each native Bayer pattern to canonical RGGB by a whole-image rotation or flip before packing. To improve the diversity of natural textures, we synthesize training pairs from LSDIR [ 26 ] in addition. Following Brooks et al . [ 5 ] , we invert the sRGB transfer function, color correction, and white balance, and remosaic the camera-linear image. Then calibrated Poisson–Gaussian noise is added with parameters from recalibrated SIDD camera noise profiles [ 44 ] . Table 2 summarizes the resulting splits and patch counts of our training datasets.

blocks.en: Applying a RAW restorer to decoded input without adaptation understates what a cascade can achieve, since codec artifacts shift its input distribution. We therefore fine-tune a separate NAFNet for every codec and rate point, especially on SIDD (see Fig. 6 ). All main comparisons use these adapted backends. Ballé18 [ 4 ] and ELIC [ 20 ] are trained under the same noisy-RAW-to-clean-RGB objective as our models, so the comparison isolates the coding architecture rather than the training target. Every curve point comes from a checkpoint that completed both fixed 1024-image validations, and all rates are measured from the resulting bitstreams rather than taken from nominal codec labels.
blocks.zh: 应用RAW还原器来解码输入而无需适应,低估了级联所能实现的目标,因为编码文物会改变其输入分布. 因此,我们针对每一个编码点和速率点,特别是SIDD对一个单独的NAFNet进行微调(见图6)。 所有主要的比较都使用这些经过调整的后端. Ballé18 [4] 和 ELIC [20] 是在与我们的模型相同的吵闹-RAW-对清洁-RGB目标下训练的,因此比较将编码架构而不是训练目标隔离. 每个曲线点都来自一个既完成了固定的1024图像验证的检查点,所有速率都从产生的比特流中测量,而不是从名义的编码标签中提取.

blocks.en: Metrics and implementation. PSNR and MS-SSIM on SIDD and LSDIR are computed in linear camera RGB. LPIPS [ 42 ] instead operates on displayed images, so reconstruction and target pass through the same metadata-derived white balance, color correction, and gamma correction before LPIPS is computed. All metrics are evaluated in Float32. For deployment measurements only, graphs are compiled to FP16 with QNN O3 and profiled on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 device (Xiaomi 13); Rokid Glass (AR1 Gen 1) uses a separately profiled W8A8 INT8 sender on QNN HTP.
blocks.zh: 计量与实施. SIDD和LSDIR上的PSNR和MS-SSIM用线性相机RGB计算. LPIPS [42] 转而运行在显示的图像上,因此在计算LPIPS之前,重建与目标通过相同的元数据产生的白色平衡,颜色校正,以及伽玛校正. 所有衡量标准都用Float32评价。 仅用于部署测量,将图用QNN O3编译为FP16,并在Snapdragon 8 Gen 2设备(小米13)上进行剖面;Rokid Glass(AR1 Gen 1)在QNN HTP上使用单独剖面的W8A8 INT8发送器.

blocks.en: 4.2 Rate–Restoration Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 比率-恢复性能

blocks.en: Target-rate comparison. Table 3 fixes one operating point on each dataset. On SIDD near 0.25 bpp, Ours-M reaches 52.90 dB and leads every compressed system on all three metrics, improving on the adapted cascades by more than 1.5 dB; the residual gap to uncompressed NAFNet is 1.05 dB, obtained at one-fortieth of the transmitted rate. Ours-S attains 52.82 dB with less than half the sender MACs, though at 0.3026 bpp (bits per pixel) it falls outside the same-rate window and is left unranked rather than treated as a competitor at this point. On LSDIR near 1.0 bpp the margin is narrower in fidelity but not in perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: 目标率比较. 表3在每个数据集上固定一个操作点. 在接近0.25 bpp的SIDD上,Ours-M达到52.90 dB,并引导所有三个度量衡上的每个压缩系统,在经过改造的级联上提高1.5 dB以上;未压缩的NAFNet的剩余缺口为1.05 dB,以传输速率的四分之一获得. Ours-S获得52.82 dB,发送器MAC不到一半,不过在0.3026 bpp(每像素的位数)时,它会落在同一速率窗口之外,因此没有排名,目前没有作为竞争者对待. 在接近1.0 bpp的LSDIR上,比值在忠诚度上较窄,但在知觉上则不高。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows a real 4032 × 3024 4032\times 3024 capture from a Rokid Glass (IMX681, ISO 800), processed with the original FP32 checkpoints and no sensor-specific fine-tuning. At about 0.028 bpp, Ours-M and Ours-S retain text and fine texture, whereas VVC+NAFNet spends 0.038 bpp yet reaches a lower PSNR (31.95 vs. 32.45 dB for Ours-M). Here PSNR is measured in sRGB against a 32-frame mean reference, rather than the clean linear-RGB targets used above.
blocks.zh: 图4显示从Rokid Glass(IMX681,ISO 800)捕获的4032 × 3024 4032\times 3024,经过原FP32检查站处理,没有针对传感器的微调。 在大约0.028 bpp时,Ours-M和Ours-S保留文字和精细的纹理,而VVC+NAFNet花费0.038 bpp却达到了较低的PSNR(31.95 vs 32.45 dB for Ours-M). 这里的PSNR是参照32帧的平均值,而不是上面使用的干净的线性-RGB目标来测量的.

blocks.en: Curve-level comparison. Comparisons at a single operating point are biased toward whichever method happens to land closest to the target rate. Table 4 therefore reports BD-rate over the full rate–quality curves, anchored on JXL+NAFNet, the only method whose quality range overlaps with all others. Ours-M achieves the best BD-rate on all six dataset–metric combinations, and Ours-S ranks second on five, outperforming ELIC there at roughly half its encoder latency (see Tab. 5 ). The two learned baselines further show that the training objective alone is not sufficient: although Ballé18 and ELIC are trained on the same noisy-RAW-to-clean-RGB objective as our models, Ballé18 exceeds +100% on SIDD (PSNR), whereas ELIC reaches -66%. Architecture therefore matters as well, and since Ours-M surpasses ELIC on every metric without a context model, our gains do not rely on serial entropy coding that the sender cannot afford.
blocks.zh: 曲线水平比较. 单一操作点的比较偏向于最接近目标率的着陆方法。 因此,表4以JXL+NAFNet为基础,在全速率质量曲线上报告BD率,这是质量范围与所有其他方法重叠的唯一方法。 我们的... M在所有六个数据集的计量组合上都取得了最佳的BD率,而Ours-S在五个组合中排名第二,以大约一半的编码机空档率(参见Tab.5)优于该组合。 所学的两个基线进一步表明,单靠培训目标是不够的:虽然Ballé18和ELLC是根据与我们的模型相同的吵闹-RAW-对清洁-RGB目标进行培训的,Ballé18在SIDD(PSNR)上超过了+100%,而ELLC则达到了−66%。 因此,建筑也很重要,而且由于我们的M在每一个度量标准上都超过了ELIC,而没有上下文模型,我们的收益并不依赖于发送者无法负担的序列式 en编码.

blocks.en: Table 4 : BD-rate ( ↓ % \downarrow\% ) benchmark relative to JXL+NAFNet. The best and second-best performing methods in the benchmark are indicated in bold and underlined, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表4:相对于JXL+NAFNet的BD-率(%\ downarrow% )基准. 基准中最佳和次最佳业绩方法分别用黑体和下划线表示。

blocks.en: Operating region. Our gains are largest where wearable capture operates. On SIDD, whose noisy, texture-sparse scenes compress to low rates, Ours-M leads the strongest cascade, VVC+NAFNet, by 70.5% BD-rate in PSNR; on texture-rich LSDIR the margin is 18%. This trend follows the argument in Sec. 1 : At low bitrates, bits spent encoding noise leave fewer bits for the underlying signal. At the high bitrate region (toward 1.0 bpp) of the LSDIR dataset, the cascade keeps improving towards the uncompressed baseline while our models saturate (see Fig. 5 ), consistent with the capacity saturation of compact learned transforms [ 36 , 24 ] . This is a deliberate trade-off: the edge budget keeps the sender small, and such rates exceed what wearable links typically sustain.
blocks.zh: 运营区域. 在可穿戴的捕捉作业中,我们的收益最大。 在SIDD上,其吵闹的纹理散射场景压缩为低速率,Ours-M带领最强级级联,VVC+NAFNet,在PSNR中比70.5%的BD率;在纹理丰富的LSDIR中,比值为18%. 这一趋势遵循第1节的论点: 在低比特率时,花费的编码噪声为基础信号留下的比特较少. 在LSDIR数据集的高比特率区域(向1.0 bpp),级联在我们的模型饱和度(见图5)的同时,不断向未压缩基线改进,这符合紧凑的学习型变换的能力饱和度[36,24]. 这是有意的权衡:边缘预算使发送者保持小幅,而这种比率超过了通常维持的可穿戴链接。

blocks.en: 4.3 Performance Across Noise Levels
blocks.zh: 4.3 整个噪音水平的业绩

blocks.en: Figure 7 isolates the effect of input SNR by holding scene content fixed. We corrupt 128 paired LSDIR scenes with one calibrated SIDD S6 profile at five ISO levels, and every system keeps a single checkpoint and a single global codec setting throughout. For the rate panel, VVC and JPEG-XL are matched to Ours-M once at the lowest ISO and then frozen. Because the coded rates diverge with ISO, the quality panel should be read as a robustness trend rather than as a same-rate comparison at every point.
blocks.zh: 图7通过持有场景内容固定来隔离输入SNR的效果. 我们腐蚀了128对 LSDIR 场景,在 5 个ISO 级别上有一个校准的 SIDD S6 剖面图,每个系统在整个过程中都有一个检查点和一个全球代码设置. 对于速率面板,VVC和JPEG-XL在最低的ISO中一次被匹配到Ours-M,然后被冻结. 由于编码的速率与ISO不同,质量面板应该被解读为稳健趋势,而不是每个点的相同速率比较.

blocks.en: All systems degrade smoothly as SNR falls, and Ours-M follows the trend of uncompressed NAFNet while staying closer to it than the cascade at every level. Its gap to that uncompressed reference narrows from 3.07 dB at ISO 200 to 1.45 dB at ISO 3200, which indicates that compression accounts for a smaller share of the total error once the observation is strongly noise limited. The rate panel shows the mechanism from the other side: over the same range Ours-M contracts from 0.414 to 0.346 bpp, a 16.5% reduction, whereas fixed-QP VVC expands from 0.420 to 0.701 bpp, a 66.9% increase, and the direction holds across nearly all scenes. This is the behavior Eq. 3 predicts, since our training objective function gives no credit for coding meaningless and high-entropy noise whereas conventional codecs are designed to reproduce the noisy input faithfully.
blocks.zh: 所有系统都随着SNR的衰落而平稳地退化,Ours-M遵循了无压缩的NAFNet的趋势,同时与各级的级联保持较接近. 它与这个未压缩的参考物的间隙从ISO 200的3.07 dB缩小到ISO 3200的1.45 dB,这表明一旦观测受到强烈噪声限制,压缩占总误差的一小部分. 费率面板显示来自另一边的机制:在同一范围内,Ours-M合同从0.414到0.346 bpp,减少16.5%,而固定QP VVC则从0.420增加到0.701 bpp,增加66.9%,方向几乎覆盖所有场景。 这就是Eq. 3预测的行为, 因为我们的训练目标功能 没有功劳 编码无意义和高强度的噪音 而常规的编码器 被设计成 忠实地复制噪音输入。

blocks.en: 4.4 Edge Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 边际效率

blocks.en: We deploy our joint compression and restoration models on edge devices and report parameter counts and MACs for both the encoder and the decoder, along with sender-side NPU latency for 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches and full-resolution frames ( Tab. 5 ). We also report a breakdown of full-frame sender latency ( Tab. 6 ). For NAFNet and Restormer the full restoration model runs on devices, whereas for the distributed methods the cost covers only the sender NPU. Ours-S runs that sender in 0.96 ms per patch, 27.6 × \times faster than NAFNet, and the narrower Ours-S halves the sender latency of Ours-M at a cost of 3.3% BD-rate points on SIDD PSNR. Restormer has fewer parameters than NAFNet yet is much slower on the same NPU, which indicates that model parameters and MACs cannot predict real-world latency reliably.

blocks.en: 4.5 Distillation Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.5 蒸发

blocks.en: Table 7 compares the distilled Ours-S with an identical student trained from scratch under the same schedule and rate weights. Distillation reduces BD-rate in three of the four settings: by 6.2% on SIDD and 9.6% on LSDIR in PSNR, and by 7.8% on LSDIR in MS-SSIM. In PSNR, it closes about a third of the gap to the Ours-M teacher on LSDIR but only a sixth on SIDD, suggesting that distillation helps most on texture-rich content, where the narrow student is more capacity-limited. Ours-M remains stronger, but at 2.3 × \times the sender MACs and 2.0 × \times the NPU latency (see Tabs. 1 and 5 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We proposed a joint RAW compression and restoration framework for resource-constrained smart wearable devices. Our asymmetric architecture keeps only a lightweight encoder on the edge-device and offloads the computationally intensive decoder to the backend. Because the model is trained end-to-end against clean targets, the encoder learns to preserve the signal needed for reconstruction instead of spending bits on noise, as conventional codecs do, which improves both compression efficiency and reconstruction quality. We further deployed and evaluated the system on commercial smartphone and smart-glasses hardware, demonstrating its practicality under real device constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们为受资源限制的智能可穿戴设备提出了一个RAW压缩和恢复联合框架。 我们的不对称架构只保留了边缘设备上的轻量级编码器,并将计算密集的解码器卸载到后端. 由于该模型是经过训练的端对端对抗干净的目标,编码器学习保存重建所需的信号,而不是像常规的解码器那样在噪音上花费比特,这提高了压缩效率和重建质量. 我们进一步在商业智能手机和智能眼镜硬件上部署和评价了该系统,显示了它在实际设备限制下的可行性。
